senses.gloss: (b. h.) to go around, to espy, to examine; esp. to cross-examine, v. חֲקִירָה.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:9">Ab. I, 9</cite> <he>הוי מרבה לַחְקוֹר וכ׳</he> cross-examine witnesses as much as possible.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 40b:4-6">Snh. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>מדהוי ליה … חָקוֹר תַּחְקוֹר</he> the text might have read (for emphasis) thou shalt diligently inquire, or thou shalt diligently investigate (instead of the unusual phrase <he>ודרשת היטב</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 17:4">Deut. XVII, 4</cite>); a. e.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:16:1">Koh. R. to I, 16</cite> <he>הלב נ׳</he> the heart is examined (by the Lord).
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:1">R. Hash. III, 1</cite> <he>נֶחְקְרוּ העדים</he> when the evidence was closed.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 6:4">Tosef. Snh. VI, 4</cite> <he>עד שתֵּחָקֵר עדותן וכ׳</he> until their examination in court has been closed; <he>נֶחְקְרָה עדותן וכ׳</he> after it has been closed, they cannot retract. Ib. 5; a. fr.
